name: Tuskax the Rampage
bio: Among the famously-mad Voidstormers, Tuskax is considered a wild one. Even Durlag cannot calm Tuskax's boiling blood when he locks eyes with a Demon. Tuskax's armor act as his trophy room, each appendage commemorating a brutal victory over some gigantic Demon. His most prized trophy is the Demon tail he grafted onto his armor and now uses as an extra weapon. It can crush bone, you know.

Then, casts a [10% Weaken] debuff on each target hit, lasting 15s, increasing all damage taken by 10%. Then, Tuskax gains 25 Titan Mana, for each target hit.
Tuskax gains 150 Titan Mana if the target is immune to Crowd Control debuffs.

effects.label: ATK Up
effects.description: Increases the recipient's Attack stat by the indicated percentage.

effects.label: Crit DMG Up
effects.description: Increases the recipient's Crit Damage stat by the indicated percentage.

effects.label: Immunity
effects.description: Blocks Debuffs from being applied to the recipient.Immunity Buffs will not block Control Debuffs, and each Immunity buff will only negate a single Debuff before expiring. This buff can be stacked.

effects.label: Stun
effects.description: The recipient cannot move or attack, and Passive Skills are disabled.Active Skill cooldowns continue to count down as normal.The recipient will continue to take 100% damage from incoming attacks.

effects.label: Weaken
effects.description: Increase the damage the recipient takes from all attacks by the indicated percentage.
